title: First Pour
brief: "Six iron bars, quick as you can. You get six ore and four wood, and I'm counting."

title: Lean Fire
brief: "Wood's scarce this winter. Eleven bars from eleven ore, and only three logs to burn. Don't let any heat go up the chimney."

title: Morning Rush
brief: "Four loaves before the coach arrives! There's wheat for four and one log for the oven."

title: Double Batch
brief: "Eight loaves for the night shift, and we've only one log for the oven. One fire has to bake both trays."

title: Harvest Festival
brief: "Twenty-four sheaves of wheat for the festival. The whole valley is watching."

title: The Giant Pumpkin Fair
brief: "Eighteen pumpkins by the fair! Big patches, lad: pumpkins that touch come in together."
